component_structure.sidebar: Fixed desktop shell with Dark Navy background, company brand logo, navigation links (Dashboard, Client Accounts, History, Billing), quick client status indicator, and profile/logout trigger.
component_structure.dashboard_header: Includes active client selector dropdown, usage badge (e.g. '3/5 Free Pages Used'), and high-level metric summaries.

bank_statement_converter.upload_area: Drag-and-drop multi-page PDF upload with format validation (.pdf). Beneath upload hotzone, Placement A badge: '🔒 Secure 256-bit Document Isolation. Your files are automatically deleted after 1 hour.'
bank_statement_converter.loading_state: Simulated multi-step parsing progress: 'Parsing statement structure via AWS Textract...', 'Extracting tabular transaction coordinates...', 'Validating running balances...'
bank_statement_converter.data_grid: Interactive table with columns: Date, Description, Reference/Check #, Withdrawals ($), Deposits ($), Balance ($). Features search filter, row edit mode, and 'Export to Accounting Excel/CSV' action button.

merchant_payout_splitter.upload_area: CSV file upload for Toast, DoorDash, UberEats, Shopify, Stripe payout reports.
merchant_payout_splitter.controls: Interactive Commission Rate % slider/input (default 30%), platform target selector, and calculate trigger.
merchant_payout_splitter.double_entry_matrix: Visual ledger showing Debit Bank Clearing (Net Cash), Debit Delivery Commissions Expense, and Credit Gross Sales Revenue.
merchant_payout_splitter.balancing_badge: Visual ledger footer displaying Total Debits == Total Credits with prominent green badge 'Balanced: Ready to Export' and 'Download QuickBooks Journal Entry CSV' button.

component_structure.client_accounts_crud: Grid/list view of client accounts ('The Burger Shack', 'Downtown Boutique') with add client modal, edit details, and page conversion stats.
component_structure.history: Detailed history log of parsed statements and split merchant payouts with download re-trigger, status, and client tagging.
component_structure.billing: Usage meter card displaying free trial usage (X / 5 pages), pricing tier comparison grid ($99/mo Starter, $199/mo Agency), and Placement B trust badges (QuickBooks Certified, Xero Approved, Stripe Secure Checkout) adjacent to checkout trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, table rows, file upload dropzones, modals) include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='pdf-upload-dropzone', data-testid='export-csv-button', data-testid='commission-rate-input').
Implement JS components (not TSX files) matching existing React setup in /app/frontend/src.
Utilize dark navy (#0B132B / #0F172A), charcoal (#1E293B), and emerald green (#10B981) for primary states, badges, and accents across the application.
Ensure Placement A (Secure 256-bit isolation badge) is rendered under the Bank Statement PDF dropzone.
Ensure Placement B (QuickBooks Certified, Xero Approved, Stripe Secure Checkout logos/badges) is rendered adjacent to the $99 Starter tier card.
Implement realistic simulated parsing delay with AWS Textract step indicators when a bank statement PDF is dropped.
Ensure double-entry ledger calculation dynamically updates when the platform commission rate % slider/input is changed, showing balanced total debits and credits.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark colors as gradients; keep backgrounds solid or subtle glassmorphic dark navy/charcoal.
Maintain high contrast text compliance (APCA / WCAG AA) with white and light slate text on dark navy backgrounds.
Never center-align whole page app containers; preserve natural left-aligned reading hierarchy.
Provide crisp borders (1px border-slate-800) and optical padding for all metric cards and data grids.
Use Lucide React icons for functional UI elements; avoid generic AI emoji characters.
